cites.quote: `api.doctors` passes the opt-in parameter and returns the list-only row type.
links to `/appointments` filtered to that doctor and to today's date

findings.text: The interface is not precise. The opt-in query parameter on GET /api/doctors, the per-row count field, the list-only row type and the query parameters of the /appointments link are never named or typed.

cites.quote: Share one status condition between both
Tile differs; follow the ticket and raise a separate fix
The count includes appointments in any status except `Cancelled`.

findings.text: The Q-02 default makes the column share DashboardService's status condition. The stories' Q-05 default says that if the tile differs, follow the ticket (exclude only Cancelled) and raise a separate fix. With the design's default, a differing tile would break REQ-3/S-1 AC3.
